description: ADAudit Plus is running at http://localhost:8081/ (login: admin/Admin@2024). Your threat intelligence team has flagged an ongoing brute-force credential attack targeting local Windows accounts. The attack targeted one specific account with a very high number of failed login attempts. Use ADAudit Plus to: (1) investigate and identify which specific local user account was the primary target of the brute-force attack — the account with the highest number of failed logon events in the audit trail; (2) create a new technician account for the incident response team: username 'incident_handler', full name 'Incident Handler', email 'handler@corp.local', password 'Handler@2025', role 'Operator'; (3) configure Admin > Notifications to send event collection alerts to 'security-alerts@corp.local' with a frequency of 1 hour; (4) document your investigation findings in C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\brute_force_analysis.txt — name the specific account that was most heavily targeted, the approximate number of failed login attempts observed, and your recommended response action.
